module origen_021286(
    input clk50, clr, key0, key1,
    output clk1,
    output reg [6:0] out0, out1, out2, out3, out4
);

    wire clk1;
    clk50mto1 clock_divider(.clk50(clk50), .clk1(clk1));

    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [2:0] S;
    reg [1:0] i;

    always @(posedge clk1 or posedge clr) begin
        if (clr) begin
            state <= 2'b00;
            S <= 3'b000;
            i <= 2'b00;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin // Normal operation
                    S <= S + 1;
                    if (S == 3'b100) S <= 3'b000;
                end
                2'b01: begin // Slow operation
                    i <= i + 1;
                    if (i == 2'b11) begin
                        S <= S + 1;
                        if (S == 3'b100) S <= 3'b000;
                        i <= 2'b00;
                    end
                end
            endcase

            if (key0) state <= 2'b00;
            if (key1) state <= 2'b01;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (S)
            3'b000: begin
                out0 = 7'b0001001; // H
                out1 = 7'b0000110; // E
                out2 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out3 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out4 = 7'b0000001; // O
            end
            3'b001: begin
                out0 = 7'b0000001; // O
                out1 = 7'b0001001; // H
                out2 = 7'b0000110; // E
                out3 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out4 = 7'b1000111; // L
            end
            3'b010: begin
                out0 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out1 = 7'b0000001; // O
                out2 = 7'b0001001; // H
                out3 = 7'b0000110; // E
                out4 = 7'b1000111; // L
            end
            3'b011: begin
                out0 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out1 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out2 = 7'b0000001; // O
                out3 = 7'b0001001; // H
                out4 = 7'b0000110; // E
            end
            3'b100: begin
                out0 = 7'b0000110; // E
                out1 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out2 = 7'b1000111; // L
                out3 = 7'b0000001; // O
                out4 = 7'b0001001; // H
            end
            default: begin
                out0 = 7'b1111111; // All segments off
                out1 = 7'b1111111;
                out2 = 7'b1111111;
                out3 = 7'b1111111;
                out4 = 7'b1111111;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module clk50mto1(
    input clk50,
    output reg clk1
);

    reg [24:0] counter;

    always @(posedge clk50) begin
        if (counter == 25'd24999999) begin
            counter <= 25'd0;
            clk1 <= ~clk1;
        end else begin
            counter <= counter + 1;
        end
    end

endmodule
